title: Working with Files, Images, and Documents

questions.prompt: You upload a 400-page PDF and ask about a chart on page 250. What happens?

options.text: Claude reads only the text of PDFs over 100 pages, so it can't see the chart
The upload is rejected because PDFs are not supported
Claude reads only the first page

questions.explanation: For PDFs of 101–1000 pages Claude processes text only. Visual analysis applies to PDFs of 100 pages or fewer, so extract the pages or send a screenshot.

questions.prompt: Which file types can Claude create when code execution and file creation is on? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: With code execution and file creation enabled, Claude can create and edit Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and PDF files.

questions.prompt: Claude's code for creating files runs in an isolated, sandboxed ____, separate from your systems.
questions.explanation: File creation happens in an isolated, sandboxed container where Claude writes and runs code.

questions.prompt: Match each limit to its value (as of writing).

pairs.left: Max size per file in a chat

questions.explanation: Chat uploads allow 500 MB per file and 20 files per chat; PDFs up to 1000 pages; project files up to 30 MB each.

questions.prompt: Order the steps for a grounded answer from a long document.

items.text: Ask Claude to quote the relevant passages with page numbers

questions.explanation: Upload, have Claude quote relevant passages with page references, answer from those quotes, then verify the citations.

questions.prompt: According to the Help Center, what eliminates the prompt-injection risk of the file-creation sandbox?

options.text: Disabling network access for the sandbox

questions.explanation: The main risk is malicious instructions making Claude run untrusted code or send data out; the Help Center says disabling network access eliminates this risk entirely.
